title: Demand Forecasting for Industrial Raw Materials
raw_text: Vanterra Minerals SA supplies industrial raw materials to 200 B2B customers with highly variable, contract-negotiated demand. Planning is done in spreadsheets against a stale extract, and stockouts on high-value lines are routine. We require machine learning based demand forecasting per material and customer, trained on eight years of order history plus price and seasonality drivers. Forecasts must be explainable enough for buyers to challenge, and must expose a confidence band rather than a point estimate. The project includes integration between our ERP order data and the forecasting output, plus a dashboard in which planners can override a forecast and have the override captured as training signal.
requirements: Machine learning demand forecasting per material and customer
Explainable forecasts with confidence bands, not point estimates
ERP order data integration feeding the forecasting pipeline
Planner override captured as training signal
